newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche MG downgrades Munich Re.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche MG downgrades Munich Re.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said on Tuesday it had downgraded its recommendation for Munich Re, the world's largest reinsurer, to "neutral" from "overweight".

Deutsche MG said it had also cut its earnings per share estimate for the company to 105 marks from 139 marks, for the 1996/97 financial year and to 106 marks from 134 marks for the 1997/98 business year.

Michael Drepper, analyst at Deutsche MG, said the downgrade was prompted by disappointment over management at Munich Re. He said Munich Re management had not decided to improve the "shareholder value" of the company.
Munich Re shares had also suffered after the firm said on Monday it could post a fall in profits for the 1996/97 financial year, under the previous year's 595 million marks.
The stock fell after the statement and extended a drop on Tuesday, slipping 50 marks to 3,680 marks in early bourse trade.
